raw.rationale: Ramatroban is a potent TP (TBXA2R) antagonist and CRTH2 (PTGDR2) antagonist with no known broad cytotoxic or antiproliferative mechanism at 2.5 µM; PRISM single-agent screens of non-cytotoxic GPCR antagonists typically show no lineage-selective killing, and any apparent selectivity would be rare and driven by chance or lineage-specific prostanoid signaling dependencies. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the stated base rate for all lineages.
